systems.system: Project BRIDGE (Building Resilient Digital Infrastructure for Growth)
systems.owner: public-private partnership through an independent special-purpose vehicle; Federal Ministry of Communications, Innovation and Digital Economy
systems.tiers: planned: at least 90,000 km across all 36 states and the Federal Capital Territory, connecting more than 770 local government areas; start given as October 2026

note: On execution risks of the national fibre project; in this document it is described as connecting local government areas, with no local government office named, and local governments otherwise appear as a source of inconsistent policies on fibre deployment.
